route_title: Defect-Cavity Stack for Sharp Telecom Transmission Peak
compilation_rationale: Request defines a complete 21-layer sequence (HfO2/SiO2)x5 | HfO2 | (SiO2/HfO2)x5 on fused silica with explicit incidence conditions. Material registry resolves coefficients automatically. Coherent TMM applies for sub-wavelength-to-few-micron planar stacks. Two targets enforce broadband visible reflection and 1550 nm cavity resonance. Bounds initialized to physical half-wave/quarter-wave estimates at the design wavelength.
